fields.title: PFIZER INC General SEC Filings
capital_markets_activity: Recent filings include debt issuance and financing-related 8-K disclosure.
capital_allocation_activity: Capital Allocation Framework ––Our capital allocation framework is designed to enhance long-term shareholder value and is based on three core pillars: maintaining and, over the long term, growing our dividend, reinvesting in the business and the potential to make share repurchases after de-levering our balance sheet.
In December 2018, the BOD authorized a $ 10 billion share repurchase program to be utilized over time and share repurchases commenced thereunder in the first quarter of 2019.
liquidity_notes: ANALYSIS OF FINANCIAL CONDITION, LIQUIDITY, CAPITAL RESOURCES AND MARKET RISK We believe that with our ongoing operating cash flows, together with our financial assets, access to capital markets, revolving credit agreement, and available lines of credit, we have and will maintain the ability to meet our liquidity needs to support ongoing operations, our capital allocation objectives, and our contractual and other obligations for the foreseeable future.
governance_notes: Recent 8-K filings include governance and board composition updates.
controls_and_risk_notes: CONTROLS AND PROCEDURES Disclosure Controls and Procedures As of the end of the period covered by this Form 10-K, we carried out an evaluation, under the supervision and with the participation of our management, including our principal executive officer and principal financial officer, of the effectiveness of the design and operation of our disclosure controls and procedures (as such term is defined in Rules 13a-15(e) and 15d-15(e) under the Exchange Act).
